type.en-US: Steps type: fill, basic or nav.

current.zh-CN: 当前步骤，从 0 开始计数；子 Step 可用 status 覆盖状态。
current.en-US: Current step, counting from 0; a child Step can override the state with status.

initial.zh-CN: 起始序号，从 0 开始计数。

status.zh-CN: 当前步骤的状态，可选 wait、process、finish、error、warning。
status.en-US: State of the current step: wait, process, finish, error or warning.

size.zh-CN: basic 与 nav 类型的尺寸，可选 default、small。
size.en-US: Size of the basic and nav types: default or small.

hasLine.zh-CN: basic 类型是否显示连接线。
hasLine.en-US: Whether the basic type shows connecting lines.

prefixCls.en-US: Class name prefix of the root element.

onChange.zh-CN: 点击或键盘选择步骤时调用，参数为该步骤序号（initial 加索引）；点击当前步骤不调用。是函数 prop，使用方照常写 @change；传入后所有 Step 变为可点击。
onChange.en-US: Called when a step is selected by click or keyboard, with its number (initial plus index); not called for the current step. It is a function prop, bound with @change as usual; passing it makes every Step clickable.

onUpdate:current.zh-CN: v-model:current 绑定的更新函数，行为与 onChange 一致。
onUpdate:current.en-US: Update function bound by v-model:current, behaving like onChange.

default.zh-CN: Steps.Step 子节点；每个元素或组件按顺序占一个步骤位置，空白和文本除外，包装 Step 的组件同样编号。
default.en-US: Steps.Step children; every element or component takes one step position in order, whitespace and text excepted, and a component that wraps Step is numbered too.

status.zh-CN: 该步骤自己的状态；缺省时随 Steps 的 current 与 status 自动决定。
status.en-US: Own status of the step; when omitted it follows current and status of Steps.

description.zh-CN: 详情描述；nav 类型不渲染。
description.en-US: Description; not rendered by the nav type.

icon.zh-CN: 自定义图标，提供后替换状态图标，内容为空则不显示图标；nav 类型不渲染。
icon.en-US: Custom icon that replaces the status icon; empty content shows no icon. Not rendered by the nav type.
